The two v6.1.0 files are byte-identical to the ones sp1-sdk 6.3.1 installs in
~/.sp1/circuits/groth16/v6.1.0/ (sp1-prover-6.3.1/SP1_CIRCUIT_VERSION = "v6.1.0"), i.e. the circuit
the Rust half (sp1-sdk =6.3.1, sp1-zkvm =6.3.1) proves against.

The contract inside SP1VerifierGroth16.sol is named `SP1Verifier`; Sworn's spec calls it
SP1VerifierGroth16V6. Do not edit these files; re-vendor instead.
